tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search Protoperfect Labs research papers, documentation and blueprints. Every word of the query must appear. Returns up to 12 matches with the best-matching section and a snippet.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Return any public protoperfect.io page as Markdown: research papers, documentation, the glossary and its terms, the FAQ, Studio, Games, About and the legal pages. Pass a path such as /research/warranted-agency or a full protoperfect.io URL.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List public pages with their titles, URLs and summaries. Optionally limit to one section: research (papers and case studies), documentation (architecture, blueprints, glossary, FAQ) or company (home, Studio, Games, About and the other hand-built pages).

tools.name: define_term
tools.description: Return the Protoperfect glossary definition of a term (for example "Warranted Agency" or "Context Window"), with its category, related terms and the paper that covers it. Suggests close matches when there is no exact term.
